introduction: Return a lost ring, choose among Alorka’s four token crafts, trade a painting for fish, feed the goldfish and examine the leprechaun’s pot exchange. Exact materials and accepted outcomes stay distinct.
orientation: Two reciprocal Surface routes meet the dusty clearing29400: NORTH or EAST from the neighboring Surface hills enters Harrow. Main streets link crafts, shops, homes, gardens, the workshop, cave and lake. Terrain, visibility, existing doors and combat still apply; source locations do not guarantee safe access.

Ask the girl lost, ring or sad; ask Alorka treasure, craft or list; ask Bom fish, artsy, items or trade, or hi or hello. These twelve aliases select four response families. Seventeen qc_action messages are ambient scenes, not keyword achievements. MA/QA make responses visible to the room; they do not make requests automatic.

Return the hidden garden ring29405 for token29406. The girl departs. Each of Alorka’s four recipes consumes a fresh token plus two exact inputs. A supplied token works without your own ring receipt; an earlier receipt never restores a spent token or completes the other crafts.

Horn: stylish horn from the lonely bard plus hidden glass carried by Brwra. Robe: hidden tunnel silk plus the instructor’s worn simple robe. Wand: children’s scrap cloth plus a sleeping artist’s hidden doll. Sack: Lomya’s leather alchemist sack plus Torker’s faerie dust. Shop horns, cloth bolts, gallery paintings and other toys are different items.

The actual light reward is a wand, despite native sphere/staff wording. Lomya carries finite stock of the finished lucky sack in addition to producing its leather input. Buying or receiving the finished sack does not record Alorka’s craft. Hidden/worn proof and live stock need actual admission; no added source-kill, carving, learning or magical garden-belt requirement is inferred.

Bom on the lakeside29461 accepts the near-finished artists’ painting29440 and gives pike318, lobster319 and crab330. The colorful floor painting29433 does not fit. Fishing or eating the reward is separate; imported fish also support foreign recipes, which are not Harrow outcomes.

The fishbowl at29443 has an existing fixed ENTER route to29472. Fish food starts at29473 and29475; matching goldfish in29472–75 share one experience exchange. Return via the existing JUMP fishbowl object at29472. Water, arrival and portal rules remain native. The whale in29474 carries the pot of gold; possession does not prove defeating it.

The leprechaun’s lucky-star hub29477 connects to29478–81;29480 has a one-way return to main room29476. No ordinary incoming route or fixed incoming portal was identified. Plan access with a builder before inventing a key, luck, pipe, clover, random-travel prerequisite or new passage. His accepted recipe consumes the pot item, rewards clover and coins, and makes him depart.

The waterfall29469 has native fall/current metadata and a fixed ENTER waterfall route to altar29470; WEST returns to29469. Workshop29440 has ordinary stairs plus existing fixed observatory ENTER/return portals. The telescope is scenery. Hearing altar lore, entering a portal or seeing stars is not a recorded learning/access milestone.

Nine native shop records cover sacks, clothes, craft supplies, food, jewelry, toys, flowers, masks and instruments. Shared boot/keeper dispatch and current stock matter. The art instructor uses the flag-based teacher handler;29403 has the explicit inn handler. Paint set29420 appears in a non-door exit key field, not an implemented locked art gate.

All eight accepted outcomes retain exact native input, reward and departure identities. Current loose proof, original source, gifts, addressed dialogue, access, teaching and accepted receipts remain separate. Daily candidates need actual material/stock/recipient renewal under mode2; static eligibility does not prove renewal.

All new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit requires active, ready accounting; frozen recovery remains separate. No native quest/zone repair, pickup, shop, route, charge, teaching or PvP change ships. Preserve the owner-confirmed Fields Between rift hotfix and its required replacement design.
